name: couchlist
description: A community directory of good places to watch and read.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @couchlist/shared && npm run build --workspace @couchlist/db && npm run build --workspace @couchlist/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run build --workspace @couchlist/shared && vitest run tests/unit
scripts.test:integration: npm run build --workspace @couchlist/shared && vitest run tests/integration
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build --workspace @couchlist/shared && npm run migrate --workspace @couchlist/db
scripts.db:deploy: npm run build --workspace @couchlist/shared && npm run deploy --workspace @couchlist/db
scripts.db:seed: npm run build --workspace @couchlist/shared && npm run seed --workspace @couchlist/db
scripts.db:reset: npm run build --workspace @couchlist/shared && npm run reset --workspace @couchlist/db
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.watch:sources:import: npm run build --workspace @couchlist/shared && npm run import:watch-sources --workspace @couchlist/db --
scripts.db:seed:guides: npm run build --workspace @couchlist/shared && npm run seed:guides --workspace @couchlist/db
scripts.admin:grant: npm run build --workspace @couchlist/shared && npm run admin:grant --workspace @couchlist/db --
scripts.check:links: npm run build --workspace @couchlist/shared && npm run check:links --workspace @couchlist/db --
